pages.title: Cyanite Reprocessor
pages.text: A single block machine that turns reactor waste back into something useful. Feed it $(thing)Cyanite$(), water and RF, and it gives you $(thing)Blutonium$().$(br2)It has an item slot, a fluid tank and an energy buffer, all visible in its interface.

pages.title: Running it
pages.text: Place it, give it power from any Forge Energy source, and pipe or bucket water into it.$(br2)Cyanite goes in the input slot, blutonium comes out the other side. Hoppers work on both, and the machine faces whichever way you were looking when you placed it.

pages.title: Why bother
pages.text: Blutonium is a denser fuel than uranium and burns hotter, and it is also the crafting ingredient for the more advanced reactor parts.$(br2)Reprocessing means a reactor eventually feeds itself: the waste it makes becomes the fuel it burns.
